deliveryRules.noVisibleFeatureDescriptions: Prompts should guide immediate action, not advertise systems.

prompts.title: A Handle
prompts.body: A stick can become a handle. Find stone and fiber to bind a crude tool.

prompts.title: Stone Edge
prompts.body: Stone pieces can shape a crude axe, pick, or echoworldstarter:campfire ring.

prompts.title: Binding
prompts.body: Twist fiber into binding before making tools.

prompts.title: First Tool
prompts.body: Use tools to gather wood, stone, echomaterialcore:clay, and shelter materials faster.

prompts.title: Warm Light
prompts.body: A echoworldstarter:campfire helps a shelter feel safe and can cook simple food.

prompts.title: Almost Shelter
prompts.body: A echoworldstarter:bedroll and a little more cover will make this safe enough to sleep.

prompts.title: Shelter Ready
prompts.body: This shelter is good enough. Rest at a echoworldstarter:bedroll to set your return point.

prompts.title: Old Road
prompts.body: Old road markers can point toward ruins and broken waystones.

prompts.title: Broken Waystone
prompts.body: Clear debris and repair the stone shell to wake the route.

prompts.title: Route Opened
prompts.body: The restored stone reveals nearby places and can link with another active stone.
